title: The proper projection formula on the ambient category
statement:
Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and let $r:V\to T$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] of finite type between Noetherian schemes (locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth] and quasi-compact [def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme]). Work on the small etale sites and in the ordinary unbounded derived categories $D(V_{\Et},A)$ and $D(T_{\Et},A)$ of [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], with derived tensor as in [def-kun-derived-tensor]. Write $r^*=r^{-1}$ for the termwise exact inverse image of constant-coefficient module sheaves [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact], and $Rr_*$ for its derived right adjoint. For every $L\in D(V_{\Et},A)$ and $K\in D(T_{\Et},A)$, the canonical derived tensor projection map
$$
K\otimes_A^L Rr_*L\longrightarrow Rr_*(r^*K\otimes_A^L L)
$$
is an isomorphism in $D(T_{\Et},A)$. Precisely, this map is the composite
$$
K\otimes_A^L Rr_*L
\xrightarrow{\sigma}Rr_*L\otimes_A^L K
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{PF}_r(L,K)}Rr_*(L\otimes_A^L r^{-1}K)
\xrightarrow{Rr_*(\sigma)}Rr_*(r^{-1}K\otimes_A^L L),
$$
where $\mathrm{PF}$ is the adjoint-of-counit map of [def-kun-projection-formula-map], and $\sigma$ is the canonical derived tensor symmetry of [lem-kun-tensor-sym], represented by the sign $(-1)^{pq}$ swap on K-flat complexes in bidegree $(p,q)$. No boundedness, constructibility, finite Tor amplitude, pro-etale completion, or invertibility of $|A|$ on the schemes is assumed.

proof.text: Apply AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.isIso_rightDerivedLowerStarProjectionMap_of_finite with coefficient ring A and proper morphism r (lem-etale-proper-projection-formula-finite). The existing theorem has exactly the canonical adjoint-of-counit projection map and needs only finiteness of A and properness of r. Its objectwise proof tests geometric pullbacks, identifies the fibre map with the constant-complex projection formula, and invokes geometric-stalk conservativity, as in the current blueprint. Take its natural-transformation component at L and then at K to obtain IsIso of the middle displayed map. No extra bound or nontriviality assumption is introduced.

The symmetry maps s on T and t on V are components of the canonical natural isomorphisms derivedTensorSymmetry (lem-kun-tensor-sym), so they are isomorphisms. The derived direct-image functor takes t to an isomorphism. The displayed map is exactly s followed by the middle projection map followed by Rr_*(t); the Mathlib instances for components, functor images and composition of isomorphisms prove IsIso of this composite. Equivalently, compose Rr_*(t.inv), the inverse projection map, and s.inv to obtain its inverse.

blueprint_update.statement:
Let $r:V\to T$ be a proper
morphism of finite type between Noetherian schemes. For all complexes
$L$ on $V$ and $K$ on $T$, the canonical
derived tensor projection map is an
isomorphism in the ordinary
derived category:

$$
K\otimes_A^LRr_*L\longrightarrow Rr_*(r^*K\otimes_A^LL).
$$

proof.text:
Test the projection map of
[def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map] at a geometric point
$\bar t$. It becomes the constant-coefficient map

$$
K_{\bar t}\otimes_A^LR\Gamma(V_{\bar t},L|_{V_{\bar t}})
\longrightarrow
R\Gamma(V_{\bar t},\underline{K_{\bar t}}\otimes_A^LL|_{V_{\bar t}}).
$$

Both sides, as functors of $K_{\bar t}\in D(A)$, are exact
and preserve coproducts. This follows on the right from the coproduct result
[lem-amb-proper-coproducts] applied over the geometric point. The comparison is the
identity for $K_{\bar t}=A$. The shifts of $A$ generate
$D(A)$ under coproducts and cones: free resolutions and their
truncations give the usual explicit construction. Hence the map
is an isomorphism for every $K_{\bar t}$. [lemma-weil-pbc-geometric-stalk-conservative] proves the assertion on $T$.
